scope: E0 only; A1-A4 and A7 interim precedes E1/E2 analysis or production

heading.complex_signal: Retained P=M1/M1(initial); R=abs(P), not q1 coherence
heading.cosine: cos(arg(P(t+lag))-arg(P(t))); both endpoints must be valid
heading.lags: Every scalar cadence from one step through half the analysis window
heading.aggregation: Sum eligible cosine numerators and pair counts over independent whole seeds
heading.coverage: Eligible endpoint pairs divided by all time-separated pairs; retain every lag

bootstrap.unit: Whole independent noisy realization; never individual frames
bootstrap.pairing: Independent conditions; reuse each condition's seed-resampling weights across its window/cadence sensitivities
bootstrap.interval: 2.5% and 97.5% empirical quantiles; retain infinite or unresolved endpoints
bootstrap.outer_strength_warning: Two-seed ensembles have only two independent realizations despite 2000 bootstrap draws

persistence.crossing: First sampled crossing; linear interpolation is descriptive within its saved lag bracket
persistence.unresolved: Crossing below two scalar cadence steps, including a first-lag crossing
persistence.censoring: No crossing by the maximum requested lag is a lower bound; no exponential extrapolation
persistence.evaluable: Coverage at the crossing bracket or censoring lag >=0.5 in both compared sizes, and persistence resolved or bounded
persistence.single_exponential: Comparison only: exp(-lag/tau), weighted least squares on finite cosine values; fitted tau cannot replace an empirical bound

angular_MSD.tracks: Unwrap only contiguous R-valid sections; never bridge an undefined heading gap
angular_MSD.fit: Free-intercept linear regression of MSD against lag; D_theta is half the signed slope
angular_MSD.nonpositive_slope: Retain the signed estimate and flag a nonpositive diffusivity as unresolved
angular_MSD.coverage: Report the separate fraction of possible pairs lying in valid contiguous sections
angular_MSD.interpretation: Measured short-lag angular mobility; free diffusion is not assumed

physical_site.qualification: Exactly one raw half-contrast component, contrast >=0.1 times the exact basal contrast, and R>=0.1 throughout each track
physical_site.primary_coordinate: Integrate shortest angular increments multiplied by midpoint actual circumference/(2*pi); reset the spatial origin at each valid track start
physical_site.dilation_gauge: Primary increments exclude an origin-dependent displacement caused by uniform circumference change
physical_site.direct_map_sensitivity: Unwrapped heading relative to the track's initial heading, multiplied by actual C(t)/(2*pi)
physical_site.peak_sensitivity: Peak maximum position from saved profiles; flag the coarser 40/4 cadence
physical_site.Dx_conversion: D_theta times the squared second-half actual mean circumference/(2*pi), reported beside direct physical-track MSD
physical_site.geometry_reference: Show the brief's ratio 9 and the measured squared large/small actual-circumference ratio

regime.single: One raw half-contrast component and passed relative contrast gate
regime.multiple: At least two raw half-contrast components and passed relative contrast gate
regime.low_contrast: Current contrast below 0.1 times exact basal contrast
regime.majority: Strictly more than 50% of saved second-half time; otherwise mixed
regime.forced: Matched mean control spends >50% of second half in the union R<0.1 OR low contrast
regime.missing_mean: Unavailable forced-state classification; never silently treated as non-forced
regime.E1_flag: Unavailable in E0; no inference from unchanged single-front states

size_ratios.primary: Largest/smallest empirical persistence; propagate censoring intervals through each whole-seed bootstrap draw
size_ratios.censored_proxy: Also show small/large short-lag D_theta ratio where persistence is censored, explicitly labelled a mobility proxy
size_ratios.matched_strengths: Only strengths directly observed at both sizes enter a size ratio; Goryachev-only refinements remain separate context
size_ratios.f_half: First crossing of half the actual weakest-noisy-input persistence, interpolated linearly against log(f) when resolved; otherwise retain bounds or inconclusive
size_ratios.no_fabrication: Two censored persistence values do not yield a finite persistence ratio or a resolved f_half

robustness.forced_inclusion: Report primary non-forced decisions and forced-inclusive results alongside
robustness.horizon_extension: Unavailable until E4; no E0 extrapolation

decision_status: Provisional per-model H1/H2 and explicit pending A6/E1/E2/E4 dependencies; no unconditional overall support claim from incomplete criteria
